# ZDF

> > ZDF (Zweites Deutsches Fernsehen) is Germany's national public television broadcaster, offering documentaries, news, entertainment, and children's programming.

ZDF provides comprehensive German-language content including the acclaimed 37 Grad documentary series exploring real-life stories, historical programming commemorating significant events like WWII, and diverse content through channels like ZDFtivi and ZDFinfo.

## Key Topics

- 37 Grad documentary series
- ZDFtivi children's programming
- German documentaries and reportages
- Social issues and personal narratives
- Life challenges and human stories
- Mental health awareness
- Youth-focused content (stark!)
- Historical commemorations (WWII)
- ZDFinfo factual programming
- German public television
- Documentary archives
- Contemporary social topics
- Personal storytelling

## 37 Grad Documentary Series

- [37 Grad](https://www.zdf.de/37-grad-196): 37 Grad documentary series: authentic stories about life challenges
- [Alle 37 Grad Geschichten](https://www.zdf.de/37-grad-alle-dokus-100): Complete archive of 37 Grad documentaries and reportages

## Historical Programming

- [80 Jahre Ende des Zweiten Weltkrieges](https://www.zdf.de/80-jahre-ende-des-zweiten-weltkrieges-in-europa-100): 80th anniversary WWII end: films, docs, interviews on May 8, 1945
